games.name: SCP: Site Roleplay
games.desc:
Hidden beneath the frozen tundra of Northern Canada lies SCP Foundation Containment Site-64, an ultra-classified facility controlled by an organization that studies and contains the supernatural. Site-64 operates at the brink of catastrophe at all times, facing constant escape attempts by dangerous anomalies, violent sabotage by Chaos Insurgents or Hostile Test Subjects, and a relentless scientific drive to research, even when doing so endangers the world.

Defend the facility as a Security, discover the unknown as a Scientist, endure dangerous experiments as a Class-D, or fight to dismantle the Foundation as an Insurgent or Hostile Test Subject. 

SECURE. CONTAIN. PROTECT.

📋Gameplay Rulebook: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/4715675

⚙️V4.1.0 Patch Notes:

-🏹 Ranger
-🪄 Wizard
-🗡️Assassin

games.name: [ALPHA] Route 06
games.desc:
⚠️ The game is on a alpha stage and plenty of features are still underdeveloped and unpolished, everything is subject to change. ⚠️

Welcome to Route 06! A CO-OP game where you and 4 more friends drive across a randomly generated map with randomly generated structures, fighting to survive and using what you can to defend yourself along the way.

Use a variety of different survivors each having their own abilities and fight hordes of zombies, with some of them having their own unique tweaks to spice up each run! 

The game tries to give the player as much freedom as possible, giving you a chance to play the game at your own pace and however you want.

games.name: Iron Man: Playground
games.desc:
Step into the suit of Ironman in this thrilling Roblox game! Fly through the skies, unleash powerful energy blasts, and take on intense battles with thugs or players. Experience the excitement of being a superhero. Whether you're battling enemies or exploring new locations, the Ironman experience brings all the action to life in an immersive Roblox world!

CONTROLS:
- G: Call Suit / Change Weapon
- E: Repulser
- Q: Secondary Weapon
- F: Hover
- Left Shift: Flight Accelerate / Sprint
- N: Eject/Send
- M: Faceplate
- Hold M: Helmet
- K: Sentry mode (ejected)
- X: Destroy Suit
- V: Flares
- B: Supersonic Flight 
- C: First Person Enable/Disable
- W/S: Speed up or speed down in flight mode

If you enjoyed the game please leave a like!👍
